newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon upgrades RMI.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon upgrades RMI.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Leanne Baker said she upgraded RMI Titanium Co to strong buy from buy and boosted her 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates.

-- In published remarks, the analyst said she expected the company to earn $2.20 per share in fiscal 1997, up from $1.95 per share previously and $3.25 per share in fiscal 1998 compared to her prior estimate of $2.50.

-- Baker noted that RMI's share price has weakened in recent weeks and appeared undervalued relative to others in the sector, trading at only 10.6 times her revised 1997 estimate and 7.2 times her 1998 projection.
